setup: git clone https://github.com/receiptful/escpost build/external/escpost && git -C build/external/escpost checkout c4a7665
notes: Exercises GS v 0 with every m, the raster image at single and double scale. The case names the NT-5890K profile, whose printable_width_dots is 384. The stream is the hexadecimal file of the repository, not a run of the library. Reviewed against the expected PNG of the case: the same four images with the same 48 ink rows, but 138 dots here against 48 there. The case is rendered with the NT-5890K profile, whose firmware swallows the LF that follows a raster image; this renderer follows the Epson baseline, where that LF feeds a line, so the four images are 30 dots apart here and adjacent there.
